title: Islamic Finance Basics
description: Core principles of Islamic finance including contracts, Murabaha, Ijarah, Salam, Istisna, and ethical practices based on Quran & Sunnah.
short_description: Learn the foundational concepts and prohibitions of Islamic finance

modules.title: Foundations of Islamic Finance
modules.description: Understanding contracts, wealth, and the key prohibitions in Islamic finance.

lessons.title: Introduction to Contracts & Transactions
lessons.content: The fundamentals of Islamic finance, the importance of earning a livelihood, and the Islamic law of contracts and business transactions. Covers different types of transactions, ownership categories, and key conditions within contracts that shape ethical financial practices in Islam.

lessons.title: Understanding Wealth and Money
lessons.content: Wealth and money from an Islamic perspective. Learn why wealth is both a blessing and a trial, the role of money in society, and how to use it in a way that benefits both yourself and others.

lessons.title: Key Prohibitions: Riba and Gharar
lessons.content: The key prohibitions in Islamic finance, focusing on the concepts of Riba (interest) and Gharar (uncertainty) and their implications for financial transactions.

modules.title: Modes of Islamic Financing
modules.description: Partnership-based and asset-backed financing methods in Islamic finance.

lessons.title: Partnership Mode of Finance: Musharaka & Mudaraba
lessons.content: Musharaka (joint venture) and Mudaraba (investment partnership), how profit and loss are shared, and how these concepts apply to real-world financing including home financing and business ventures.

lessons.title: Murabaha, Ijarah, Salam & Istisna
lessons.content: Asset-backed financing methods including leasing (ijarah), murabaha and forward contracts like salam and istisna. Learn how these methods contribute to real economic growth while avoiding the pitfalls of conventional financial systems.
